name: Satoyama Development Mechanism Call for Proposals

funder.name: Satoyama Development Mechanism (IGES, secretariat of the International Partnership for the Satoyama Initiative)

summary: Seed grants of up to JPY 2.2 million for up to 24 months, for IPSI member organisations to develop or carry out collaborative activities that address the Satoyama Initiative's landscape and biodiversity objectives.
reporting: Recipients must submit a final project evaluation report at the project end, and are recommended to update the secretariat on major progress.
